scope: Build record for the 0.8.1 reference package handed to the web_agent project. Records what was packaged and why; claims nothing about whether the code runs there.
archiveSha256Note: Reproducible: zip entries are pinned to a fixed timestamp, so rebuilding identical content yields this same digest.
contentSha256Note: sha256 over the sorted per-file digests, so it is independent of zip metadata.
excluded: payment and licensing sources (user asked to skip)
